description.value: Roots Café is a neighbourhood café and casual restaurant in South Vancouver run by a mother-daughter team, serving espresso drinks, fresh baked goods, and all-day meals from a full kitchen. The menu spans breakfast poutines, avocado toast, quinoa bowls, and pulled pork, with cold beer and wine also available. It occupies a full sit-down space on Main Street, making it a solid candidate for a substantial mid-ride meal stop.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website for rootscafe.ca fetched successfully and confirms the café at 6502 Main Street, Vancouver BC V5X 3G9, with phone (604) 568-8303. The website explicitly mentions vegan and gluten-free options. No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, etc.) are mentioned anywhere on the site or in the OSM tags.
concerns: OSM record has no address or phone; both sourced from website only — contact_confirmed fields are null for phone and address.
OSM coordinates place the café slightly off from 6502 Main St — worth verifying pin location matches the address.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The café is clearly a real, operating business with good food options for cyclists including vegan/GF menu items, but none of the three required WWC criteria (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) can be confirmed from the website or OSM tags. An on-site or phone verification of these basics is needed before listing.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Website states 'vegan and gluten free options' are available; menu also includes tofu substitutions and a quinoa bowl

wow_evidence: neighbourhood café...run by a mother-daughter team
